title: John Deere Z345M 42-Inch 22 HP Gas Dual Hydrostatic Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower
description:
The
John Deere
Z345M Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower is designed to deliver reliable power, smooth maneuverability, and professional-quality cutting performance for residential lawn care. Ideal for medium to large yards, this mower combines durability, comfort, and efficiency in a compact zero-turn design.
Powered by a dependable 22 HP V-Twin engine, the Z345M provides consistent performance for cutting thick grass and maintaining large lawn areas with ease. The ReadyStart system offers quick and convenient choke-free starting for simplified operation.
The 42-inch Accel Deep mower deck is engineered to improve grass lift and airflow, delivering a cleaner, more even cut while enhancing mulching and bagging performance. Dual EZT hydrostatic transmissions provide responsive zero-turn handling, smooth control, and efficient mowing speeds of up to 7 MPH.
Constructed with a heavy-duty welded steel frame, the Z345M is built for long-lasting durability and dependable operation. The mower also features an 18-inch high-back seat, ergonomic controls, and adjustable levers designed to maximize operator comfort during extended mowing sessions.
For easier maintenance, the foot platform lifts to provide convenient access to the mower deck for cleaning and servicing. A 3-gallon fuel tank allows for extended mowing time with fewer refueling stops.
Compatible with optional bagging attachments, the John Deere Z345M offers flexibility for various lawn care needs while delivering trusted performance and quality craftsmanship.
Key Specifications:
Brand: John Deere
Model: Z345M
Product Type: Zero-Turn Riding Lawn Mower
Engine Power: 22 HP V-Twin Engine
Fuel Type: Gas
Cutting Width: 42 Inches
Deck Type: Accel Deep Mower Deck
Transmission: Dual EZT Hydrostatic
Maximum Speed: Up to 7 MPH
Fuel Tank Capacity: 3 Gallons
